scope: One explicitly authorized local private organizational pilot measured through a body-free structural bundle and private report; only generalized non-linkable consequences may enter Git.

criteria.expected: Every pilot bundle declares explicit authorization, purpose, authorization time, retention rule, deletion rule, and publication policy before processing.

The public pilot contract accepts only opaque identities, structural references, metric inputs, and optional bounded human ratings; source bodies, locators, credentials, and free-text dossiers are rejected.
The CLI fails closed unless both input and output resolve inside Git-ignored private paths, and it never writes a report beside public source or documentation files.
An unchanged authorized bundle has a stable SHA-256 input identity and produces a deterministic measurement report without canonical, possibility, or runtime-database writes.

Reconstruction coverage, source-reference integrity, profile coverage, unresolved corrections, and correction burden expose explicit numerators, denominators, status, and limitations rather than an opaque quality score.
Contextual usefulness, profile-revision usefulness, and user learning remain not-observed until an attributed human rating is supplied; code cannot infer these outcomes from record counts.

Forecast specificity and calibration are measured only for purpose-typed forecasts with declared criteria and eligible assessments; absent evidence remains not-observed and is not converted into a miss.
The authorized dormant organizational record is evaluated locally, its complete report remains ignored/private, and the public evidence records only generalized non-linkable results and gaps.
The pilot boundary adds no runtime dependency, provider, service, or private-data writer and preserves the P0-P5 compatibility, supply-chain, browser, Skill, and public-content gates.
P6 reports engineering observations and gaps without claiming human acceptance, universal case semantics, live-provider quality, P7 hardening, or authorization to publish a case.
